steps.action: Tap 'Finish workout' in the sheet
user_sees: The summary 'Workout complete' replaces the live screen
must_not: The emptied workout ('0m 00s', Add exercise) shown on the way out
Two saved workouts after a double tap
Text cut off, text over other text, or the main button pushed out of reach

note: The entry bar replaces Finish while the keyboard is open
